_readme: Head motion and avatar sync, versioned. Edited from /tune (live sliders) or by hand. The dashboard writes this file and mirrors it to /dev/shm/cj_motion.json, which is what the robot's breath loop reads every cycle (app/main_voice_robot.py _motion). Before 2026-09-14 the ONLY copy was the /dev/shm one, so every setting was lost on reboot; this file is why they now survive. Values are clamped to the ranges in ui_common.MOTION_KNOBS on write, so a hand-edited out-of-range number is corrected rather than obeyed.
_target: A composed man in his late eighties who spent a career being still in a courtroom. Small deliberate shifts, nothing that snaps, and a breath that is visible at two metres without anyone consciously noticing it. If it reads as motion, it is too much.

composed._note: The default since 2026-09-14. Sway cut from 4.0 deg to 1.6 and slowed; voice emphasis nearly halved; breathing given a real rate so stillness reads as alive rather than frozen.

livelier._note: Closer to the pre-2026-09-14 behaviour. For a big room where small movement disappears, or for a camera that flattens motion.

still._note: Lowest motion that is still alive. Breathing only, no sway, no voice emphasis. Use this to check that the head never reads as a frozen frame.

_sync_offsets._note: avatar_offset in seconds, per audio route. They differ because the path from the app to the air differs. Measure with /tune while the robot speaks: drag until the mouth stops leading or trailing. UNMEASURED entries are honest placeholders, not values to trust.
_sync_offsets.dac: UNMEASURED — the USB DAC is not attached yet
